# axiz-adapter-saga-jdbc

Saga persistence and schema resources over JDBC.

Java/JDBC technology belongs here; business ports remain in `axiz-core-saga`.
Use through the matching Spring capability, or provide a transaction-aware `ConnectionProvider`.

Run `./mvnw -pl adapters/axiz-adapter-saga-jdbc -am verify` from the framework root.

## Schema and transaction boundary

The `axiz_saga` table includes `execution_owner VARCHAR(36)` and
`execution_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE` for execution leases (bootstrap schemas in
`axiz/sql/saga-*.sql`).

State and lease writes must commit before a participant is called. The Spring capability gives the
store an `AutoCommitConnectionProvider`: every operation borrows its own auto-commit connection, so
the orchestrator works the same inside a `@UseCase` or a transactional event handler, and a caller
rollback never erases saga state. A custom `ConnectionProvider` bound to the caller transaction is
rejected. Participant transactions remain local to their services. `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` is read from
the database for lease acquisition/renewal; live owner and version predicates fence state updates.
